It is silent when the same place, institution, person or company names are not read as competitors ('I grew up in Michigan', 'He studied at Duke and Yale', 'Madrid and Barcelona are cities'), and on named individual athletes ('Nadal beat Federer'), generic 'team' ('the team bus', 'the basketball team') and sports words that name no participant or result ('the tournament was cancelled', 'the Olympic Games').
